text.en:
The salaries of the Chairmen of the Civil Service Commission, Commission on Elections and the
Commission on Audit are hereby fixed at P75,000 per annum, and the Commissioners of said Constitutional
Commissions at P60,000 each per annum.

There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, such sum as may be necessary to pay the salary increases provided for in Section 1 hereof.

This Decree shall take effect on June 11, 1978.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
